Choosing between the AirPods 4 and AirPods Pro 3 essentially comes down to a trade-off between fit, features, and price. Apple is also developing AirPods equipped with cameras that support Visual Intelligence, but they aren't expected to launch until at least 2027. That means the wait could be a rather lengthy one.

AirPods 4 focuses on comfort and value, offering multiple options

The AirPods 4 feature an open design, making them a highly recommended choice if you don't like ear tips. Our AirPods 4 review found the redesigned shape comfortable to wear while retaining the convenience of everyday use.

The $129 model comes with the Apple H2 chip and personalised spatial audio, offering up to five hours of listening time, but lacks Active Noise Cancellation (ANC), Transparency mode, and wireless charging.

The $179 model adds practical noise cancellation without needing to seal the ear canal, and comes with Adaptive Audio, Transparency mode, and a wireless charging case with a built-in Find My speaker.

The open design still lets in more ambient sound, so noise cancellation will be less effective on aeroplanes and public transport.

AirPods Pro 3 offers the most complete experience

The AirPods Pro 3 are priced at $249 on Apple's website, while Amazon often offers discounts. Their foam-blend ear tips deliver stronger bass and significantly better noise cancellation. Apple claims they offer up to eight hours of battery life with ANC on, compared to just four hours for the AirPods 4 with ANC on.

They can measure heart rate during workouts and support Apple's hearing test, hearing aid, and hearing protection features. Our AirPods Pro 3 review found their workout heart rate readings to be largely consistent with Apple Watch data.

Additionally, iOS 27 adds custom EQ functionality to both models, while the AirPods Pro 3 gains an extra edge thanks to its heart rate sensor and newer charging case.

Should you wait for AirPods with Visual Intelligence?

This week, AirPods equipped with Visual Intelligence were prematurely revealed in a hidden video within the macOS Tahoe 26.7 Release Candidate. The footage appears to show someone using Siri with Visual Intelligence and camera-equipped AirPods to remember details of a book, leading to speculation that the product might be launching soon.

However, subsequent reports indicated this wasn't the case. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported that camera-equipped AirPods are still planned for a 2027 launch. The B798 model shown in the video is reportedly a modified version of the AirPods Pro 3 that has been removed from Apple's 2026 roadmap. Apple is still developing a newer generation of the B798.

Which AirPods should you buy?

If price is your top priority and you don't need noise cancellation, go for the $129 AirPods 4. If you really prefer the open fit, opt for the AirPods 4 with ANC.

For most other users, the AirPods Pro 3 remains the most worthwhile choice, especially when Amazon discounts them to a price close to the ANC-equipped AirPods 4. They offer stronger noise cancellation, longer battery life, a heart rate sensor, and Apple's hearing health features.

Today's AirPods pricing

  • AirPods 4 ($99, originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC ($148.99, originally $179)
  • AirPods Pro 3 ($189.99, originally $249)

Waiting only makes sense if Visual Intelligence is absolutely essential to you. Those needing to upgrade now could miss out on practical benefits like stronger ANC and longer battery life for over a year while waiting for an unannounced feature.

Otherwise, you should buy based on your current needs. The currently discounted AirPods already meet the practical needs of most buyers, while the future camera-equipped version will likely be priced higher or launch closer to its original retail price.
